title: UK economy grew faster than expected in July
description: The economy expanded by 0.4%, official figures show, whereas economists had predicted no growth.

title: Legalised dying bill for England and Wales faces new vote in Commons
description: The proposal was backed by a majority of MPs earlier this year but did not become law after its progress was stalled by peers.

title: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt
description: Twenty-five years on, the attacks have come to define a generation of foreign, security and intelligence policy, the BBC's security correspondent writes.

title: Anthropic blocks 'malicious use' of AI that could develop biological weapons
description: The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.

title: As Trump dominates convention, some Republicans quietly ask who comes next
description: The convention offered a stark reminder that the Trump era is heading toward its final chapter, the BBC's Washington correspondent Daniel Bush writes.

title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
description: Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.

title: Ukraine's fortress cities under fire as Russia bids to seize rest of Donbas
description: Kramatorsk and Slovyansk are now the main focus of Russian ground assaults, and residents are being told to leave.

title: New hurricane season record as 'historic' El Niño leaves Atlantic eerily quiet
description: The Atlantic hurricane season has reached its climatological peak, but a strong El Niño means no hurricanes have formed this year.

title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.
